# Next Porsche models — commercial-rights verification

Checked 2026-10-28. These are **author-published downloadable 3D-model listings**, not imported raw meshes. The individual author CC licenses permit commercial use if the artist genuinely owns the underlying mesh and textures. The vehicle design, Porsche names/logos, and separate branding rights are not granted by the mesh licenses.

## Candidate A — 1970s Porsche 911 by Philipp Busse
- Original creator: Philipp Busse (WoTiger)
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/porsche-911-e5d5f35870344bd4a005ef5599a63313
- License shown: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY)
- Listing states self-created in Blender, Substance Painter, Photoshop; 22.2k triangles.
- Good match for naturally aspirated pre-1980s coupe shape; low-poly geometry requires refinement for AAA.
- Commercial mesh rights: **promising**, subject to original-asset and texture verification.
- Import: download the creator's native Sketchfab asset, verify it, retain credit and license, inspect meshes and textures; do not use a scraped binary from unauthorized mirrors.
- Current raw file status: **not imported**. The model download is not accessible from this environment without a valid authenticated creator download.

## Candidate C — 911 Carrera 4S by Lionsharp Studios
- Creator: Lionsharp Studios
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-porsche-911-carrera-4s-d01b254483794de3819786d93e0e1ebf
- License shown: Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike (CC BY-SA)
- Listing says built for a real-time WebGL configurator; ~652.8k triangles.
- Commercial use is allowed under the listed mesh license, but attribution, license notices, and relevant ShareAlike conditions apply. Check whether third-party brand assets/textures are included.
- Current raw file status: **not imported**.

## Excluded models
- 2024 911 S/T by Ddiaz: listing says based on CSR2 game model. No reliable commercial clearance even though CC BY label is displayed.
- 2014 911 Turbo (991) by Ddiaz: based on Need For Speed Rivals, CC BY-NC-SA. Not commercially usable.
- 1992 964 Turbo S by Ddiaz: based on Need For Speed Mobile, CC BY-NC-SA. Not commercially usable.

## Repository admission rules
1. Original artist/rights holder traceable.
2. Commercial license is explicitly allowed (CC0, CC BY, verified CC BY-SA).
3. Raw redistribution is allowed (not merely game use under a marketplace standard license).
4. Game-extracted assets excluded even if an uploader labels them CC BY.
5. Preserve exact required attribution and license files. Verify maps, decals, music (if any) and other embedded third-party content.
6. Import and render-check a real model, not merely the listing, before marking 'model uploaded'.
7. Porsche trademarks and distinctive vehicle design rights require separate review for commercial game distribution.
